## Request and host capabilities

Describe the shopping request, approximate location, and available web tools. Do not include credentials or exact private addresses.

## Actual behavior

What did the assistant do? Distinguish model behavior from a helper calculation.

## Expected behavior

What should have been searched, compared, or explained?

## Evidence

Provide sanitized source observations, synthetic examples, or reproduction steps. Mark uncertain prices and fees.

## Proposed improvement

Which skill instruction, reference, or test would address the issue?
